item.title: Why NFL Playoff Underdogs Could Shape the 2026 Postseason
item.description: The NFL playoffs are defined by uncertainty. Regular-season success earns teams a place in the bracket, but once the postseason begins, outcomes are often decided by small moments rather than long-term trends. That reality has repeatedly opened the door for…

item.title: Examining How Detroit Lions Can Restructure Jared Goff’s Contract to Free Up $30 Million in Cap Space
item.description: A full breakdown of how the Detroit Lions can restructure Jared Goff’s contract and create over $30 million in 2026 salary cap space to fuel a Super Bowl push.

item.title: New York Jets Interview Detroit Lions Assistant Coach
item.description: Detroit Lions defensive assistant Jim O’Neil has interviewed for the New York Jets’ defensive coordinator position, potentially reuniting with head coach Aaron Glenn.

item.title: Former Detroit Lions OC John Morton Lands New Job
item.description: Former Detroit Lions offensive coordinator John Morton has joined the Denver Broncos as a playoff consultant, reuniting with Sean Payton.

item.title: Brad Holmes Reveals “Lessons Learned” From Frank Ragnow Situation
item.description: Lions GM Brad Holmes discusses what Detroit learned from Frank Ragnow retiring after the 2025 NFL Draft and how it impacts their approach to Taylor Decker’s future.

item.title: Michigan Football Poaches Linebacker from Michigan State
item.description: Michigan has added former Michigan State linebacker Aisea Moa via the transfer portal, giving the Wolverines an experienced Big Ten defender with one year of eligibility remaining.

item.title: Jameson Williams Reveals Offseason Focus After Career Year
item.description: Detroit Lions wide receiver Jameson Williams explains why adding strength is his top offseason goal after a breakout 2025 season and how it could elevate the offense in 2026.

item.title: Eagles Request Interview With Former Detroit Lions OC
item.description: Former Detroit Lions offensive coordinator Jim Bob Cooter is drawing interest from the Philadelphia Eagles for their OC vacancy after a strong season with the Indianapolis Colts.

item.title: NFL Insider Reveals How Mike McDaniel Feels About Detroit Lions OC Position
item.description: NFL insider Jeff Darlington reveals how Mike McDaniel feels about the Detroit Lions’ offensive coordinator opening as the coaching carousel nears its end.

item.title: Denver Broncos Get Devastating News Regarding Bo Nix
item.description: The Denver Broncos advanced to the AFC Championship Game with an overtime win over the Bills, but lost QB Bo Nix to a season-ending ankle injury, according to Adam Schefter.
